runs.content: Friday's rotation focus is Lightfin + Games + Cooking + Sports Betting + Work. Since the last thinker run (2026-09-03), log.md shows almost no activity in these domains — the only new item is today's recipe-recommender run (3 suggestions for week of 2026-09-07: One-Pan Turkey Sausage/White Bean/Kale Skillet via Lucinda Scala Quinn, Momofuku-Style Pork Belly Bao Buns via David Chang, Blackberry and Apple Crumble via Nigel Slater). Games (overview.md, prototypes.md), Sports Betting (overview.md, markets.md, bankroll-management.md), Work (overview.md) and Lightfin's raw folder are all unchanged since their last-flagged state — every angle already sits in Open Threads (GAW.L Finance idea page, Games prototype stubs, WDAY short-research gap, sports-betting bookmaker tracker, ABN-vs-Workday connection). The new bao bun recipe is explicitly framed as filling a gap in the recipe collection itself ("the single most iconic Momofuku dish hasn't made it into the collection yet") rather than pointing at anything cross-domain, and chef-david-chang.md's own Eat a Peach material is already a logged open idea (2026-07-24). No new investigation idea or cross-domain connection cleared the bar today, and nothing in the existing open sections showed signs of resolution.

Thursday's rotation focus is Books + Podcasts. Since the last thinker run (2026-09-02), log.md shows only two events: a routine MDT paper-trade entry and today's podcast-recommender run, which generated 4 new suggestions (Exponential View, The Matt Walker Podcast, Sound School Podcast, Circles Off). Books had no new activity — book-summarizer runs monthly and last fired 2026-09-01. The deep-dive centred on the fresh podcast batch, cross-checked against the full wiki map. Two genuinely new, non-duplicate finds: (1) Exponential View (Azeem Azhar) is pitched explicitly as an economist/policy voice — Fred's now-deep AI podcast list skews toward researchers, engineers, and operators, with nobody covering 'institutional and labour-market effects at a societal level.' [[ai-tech/ai-future-of-work]]'s own 'Institutional Gap' section is built entirely around this exact framing ('AI is moving at technology speed; institutions move at political speed') and its Open Questions section still asks, unresolved since May, whether any policy response actually works — a standing supply-side source for a question the page has only had one demand-side data point against (Gates' token tax, logged 2026-08-30). (2) Sound School Podcast is the first recommendation aimed at audio production itself — sound design, tape editing, pacing for the ear — explicitly distinguished by its own pitch from the two prior prose/screenwriting recommendations (Scriptnotes, Writing Excuses). [[lightfin/inspiration-authors]] covers six prose authors in depth but has zero content on audio-drama production craft, despite Lightfin Casefiles being a radio-play podcast, not a book — sharpening the still-open 2026-07-16 Scriptnotes idea, which never got past prose/screenwriting either. No new investigation idea cleared the bar today (Circles Off and The Matt Walker Podcast both repeat already-logged recommender patterns for Sports Betting and Health respectively), and nothing in the existing open sections showed signs of resolution — book-breath.md and health/source-godin-breathwork-2026.md, flagged 2026-09-01, still don't cross-link each other.
